{{Quote|Named for the famed Diathim of the moons of Iego, this light, sweet cake has an appropriately heavenly taste! (The trick for getting the cake so fluffy, we've found, is a little bit of patience and a good antigrav whisk.)|Dex's Diner menu, on its Iego angel food cake|<ref name="Menu" />}}
An '''antigrav whisk''' was a type of culinary utensil. The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used an antigrav whisk to make the [[Iego angel food cake]] served at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|coruscant]] "fluffy," although the process required a lot of patience.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Antigrav whisks were created<ref name="Story Behind">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> for "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
